gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sintony: Big, bold lowercase with open curves: that's Oxanium up top, drawn in one unbroken line. And Sintony underneath reads smooth and sturdy, its curves never clogging, with no pulse of thick and thin in the heading to compete.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-sofia-sans: Tektur looks like bent pipe cleaner, with outsized lowercase and wide-open curve endings. Sofia Sans sits beneath it with rounded, upright letters and no stroke modulation, so the display heading gets the attention while the sans-serif body stays quietly legible.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sono: Sono reads loose and approachable, with widely spaced letters and an a whose mouth stays ajar. And Unica One, bent from thin steel rod, makes the bigger statement, while Sono does the patient work of carrying words.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-stack-sans-headline: Expressive and stretched out, Warnes lets its ink strokes taper away before they touch. Stack Sans Headline follows with a deep middle band and a monoline skeleton, a plain sans that keeps the page crisp beneath the show.
gen-irish-grover-gf-stack-sans-notch: Irish Grover makes words look sturdy and big, its strokes swelling and thinning in a soft, organic cadence. But Stack Sans Notch runs flat as rod stock, with open curves you can look straight into, which gives the sans-serif body a steadier footing.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-stack-sans-text: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy pours its ink at one width with a high mean line. Stack Sans Text brings a marker-like line and well-spaced curve endings, so you can size this sans-serif body freely without crowding.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-tiktok-sans: Mystery Quest has a bookish, nostalgic air, with open jaws on every curve and compact ascenders. TikTok Sans brings the pair's strongest quality, a sans-serif body whose lowercase rises nearly to cap height and whose c opens wide.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-nunito: Nunito reads soft and friendly, with big round bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem. Oswald, tightly knit and strong, does its best work big and brief.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree reads light and unpinched, its round letters carrying no stroke modulation at all. And Oswald, confident and tightly knit, gives that plain sans a firm voice to follow on the page.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic reads modern and orderly, with a wide channel opening into every bowl. And Oswald brings confident, tightly knit strength to the big lines, while the sans-serif body handles the steady running text.
